tasks.label: Stop Portfolio on port 8080
args: $port = if ($env:PORT) { [int]$env:PORT } else { 8080 }; $listenerIds = @(Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort $port -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique); foreach ($listenerId in $listenerIds) { $listenerProcess = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId = $listenerId"; if ($listenerProcess.CommandLine -notmatch 'com\.example\.portfolio\.PortfolioApplication') { throw "Port $port is owned by PID $listenerId, not the Portfolio app; leaving it untouched." }; Stop-Process -Id $listenerId -Force }
